leaveStartDate.title: Start Date
leaveStartDate.description: The start date an employee provides when submitting their leave request.

leaveType.title: Leave Type
leaveType.description: The leave type an employee provides when submitting their leave request. It should be in yyyy-mm-dd format

leaveReason.title: Comment
leaveReason.description: The reason an employee provides when submitting their leave request.

leaveEndDate.title: End Date
leaveEndDate.description: The end date an employee provides when submitting their leave request. It should be in yyyy-mm-dd format

dailyQuantity.title: Daily Quantity
dailyQuantity.description: Specifies the daily portion of leave in hours or fraction of a day (e.g., 4 h, 0.5 day, 1 day)

serviceDefinitionId.title: Service Process Name
serviceDefinitionId.description: The id of the service process that runs to submit the leave request.

leaveTypeBalances.title: Leave Balance
leaveTypeBalances.description: The number of leaves available to apply for, including the leave types and their count.
